purpose: Distinguish short-step integration error from a learned-distribution failure without more training
trigger: Only if neither 2000-update 10-step arm passes the native quality/validity screen
weights: The existing paired and independent 2000-update checkpoints
evaluation: Same 64 tuning families and three noise seeds, with a freshly checked unchanged 25-step CFG2 baseline and batching controls
native_gate: CA-lDDT lower 95% family bound above -0.005; mean coarse-validity loss no greater than 0.01
followup: Only qualifying settings may receive frozen ensemble evaluation; all settings and failed gates remain reported
speed: Require measured K32 speedup of at least twofold over the inherited student, with sequence embedding and decoder included
test: No reserved confirmation or original independent-test predictions
